purpose: Verify that an authorized SysAdmin can trigger an on-demand manual backup.
preconditions: User is authenticated with the SysAdmin role; database connection is active.
action_or_input: SysAdmin triggers manual backup execution.
expected_result: The system accepts the request and initiates the manual backup process.

purpose: Verify that an authorized Super Admin can trigger an on-demand manual backup.
preconditions: User is authenticated with the Super Admin role; database connection is active.
action_or_input: Super Admin triggers manual backup execution.
expected_result: The system accepts the request and initiates the manual backup process.

purpose: Verify that an unauthorized user cannot trigger a manual backup.
preconditions: User is authenticated with a non-admin role (e.g., standard User or Department Head).
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to trigger manual backup execution.
expected_result: The system denies the request with an authorization error and no backup is initiated.

purpose: Verify that triggering a manual backup collects the current timestamp and required backup artifacts.
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; manual backup is triggered.
action_or_input: System processes manual backup initiation.
expected_result: System collects the current timestamp and compiles the required backup artifacts.

purpose: Verify that the system communicates with the database and saves a current-state dump with its timestamp.
preconditions: Database is reachable; manual backup is executing.
action_or_input: System performs database dump operation.
expected_result: System captures the database current state dump and persists it alongside its timestamp.

purpose: Verify that the system records and communicates backup outcome as Success or Failure.
preconditions: A backup execution run concludes.
action_or_input: System records operation completion status.
expected_result: Backup outcome is explicitly recorded and communicated as Success (or Failure).

purpose: Verify that if a backup cannot be created, system marks it Failed and alerts SysAdmin.
preconditions: SysAdmin triggers backup while database or storage failure prevents creation.
action_or_input: System attempts backup creation and encounters fatal failure.
expected_result: Backup status is recorded as Failed and an alert notification is dispatched to SysAdmin.

purpose: Verify that automatic backup executes at scheduled time without user intervention.
preconditions: An automatic backup schedule is configured and scheduler service is running.
action_or_input: System reaches scheduled execution time.
expected_result: Automatic backup executes autonomously without requiring user intervention.

purpose: Verify that automatic backup identifies and reads datasets eligible under applicable schedule.
preconditions: Multiple datasets exist under different classification and schedule criteria.
action_or_input: Automatic backup scheduler triggers for active schedule.
expected_result: System identifies and reads only the datasets matching the applicable schedule filters.

purpose: Verify that eligible data is transferred to backup recovery storage during automatic backup.
preconditions: Eligible datasets are identified; recovery storage is configured and online.
action_or_input: System executes data transfer during automatic backup.
expected_result: Eligible datasets are transferred to designated backup recovery storage.

purpose: Verify that system verifies backup integrity and consistency during automatic backup execution.
preconditions: Data transfer to backup recovery storage has completed.
action_or_input: System runs backup verification process.
expected_result: System verifies the integrity and consistency of the backup data.

purpose: Verify that system logs verified automatic backup with its timestamp and status.
preconditions: Automatic backup execution and integrity verification complete.
action_or_input: System finalizes automatic backup process.
expected_result: System writes a log record containing backup timestamp and verified status.

purpose: Verify that scheduled automatic backup executes when the repository is scheduled and reachable.
preconditions: Repository has an active schedule and is reachable over network/storage.
action_or_input: Scheduled execution time is reached.
expected_result: System proceeds with automatic backup execution.

purpose: Verify that scheduled automatic backup does not execute if the repository is unreachable.
preconditions: Repository is scheduled but unreachable.
action_or_input: Scheduled execution time is reached.
expected_result: System detects unreachability and halts backup execution, recording the failure condition.

purpose: Verify that system displays current backup schedules to an authorized SysAdmin.
preconditions: User is authenticated as SysAdmin; backup schedules exist.
action_or_input: SysAdmin requests view of current backup schedules.
expected_result: System displays current backup schedules with configured parameters.

purpose: Verify that SysAdmin can create or modify local backup schedule with frequency, time, and classification filters.
preconditions: User is authenticated as SysAdmin.
action_or_input: SysAdmin specifies frequency, execution time, and data-classification filters to create or modify local schedule.
expected_result: System accepts parameters and initiates schedule validation.

purpose: Verify that system rejects conflicting or invalid schedule parameters without applying them.
preconditions: User is authenticated as SysAdmin.
action_or_input: SysAdmin submits invalid or conflicting schedule parameters.
expected_result: System rejects the configuration with an error and does not apply the schedule changes.

purpose: Verify that system applies local backup schedule after successful validation.
preconditions: SysAdmin submits valid, non-conflicting schedule parameters.
action_or_input: System completes validation of new/updated local schedule.
expected_result: System applies the validated local backup schedule to active schedules.

purpose: Verify that system logs each backup-schedule configuration change.
preconditions: SysAdmin creates or updates a backup schedule.
action_or_input: System applies schedule configuration changes.
expected_result: A log record is created documenting schedule change details, actor identifier, and timestamp.

purpose: Verify that system maintains current status and history of all backup operations.
preconditions: Multiple backup operations have completed in the system.
action_or_input: System queries backup repository history.
expected_result: System maintains and returns historical records and current operational status for all backups.

purpose: Verify that users and authorized administrators can view backup history and current status within authorized scope.
preconditions: User and administrator sessions are authenticated.
action_or_input: User or administrator requests backup history and current status.
expected_result: System displays backup status and history restricted to the requester's authorized scope.

purpose: Verify that an authenticated user can initiate a secure archival request.
preconditions: User is authenticated in BADMS.
action_or_input: User initiates secure archival request workflow.
expected_result: System opens secure archival request submission form.

purpose: Verify that secure archival request captures file name, date, owners, file type, reason, and file attachment.
preconditions: User is on archival request submission page.
action_or_input: User inputs file name, date, owners, file type, reason for secure archival, and attaches file.
expected_result: System captures all specified metadata fields and attachment data.

purpose: Verify that system validates request details and quota, accepting valid requests.
preconditions: User has available storage quota and inputs valid archival request details.
action_or_input: User submits secure archival request.
expected_result: System validates data and quota successfully and accepts request.

purpose: Verify that validation failure or storage quota exhaustion shows errors without request-state change.
preconditions: User has insufficient storage quota or provides invalid/missing required metadata.
action_or_input: User attempts to submit secure archival request.
expected_result: System displays validation errors and rejects submission with no request-state change.

purpose: Verify that system sets status to Submitted upon successful submission.
preconditions: User submits valid secure archival request within quota.
action_or_input: System completes intake validation of the request.
expected_result: Request status transitions to 'Submitted'.

purpose: Verify that system routes submitted secure archival request to the HoD of the requester's department.
preconditions: Archival request is submitted by user in Department X.
action_or_input: System executes request routing.
expected_result: Request is routed to the HoD of Department X for review.

purpose: Verify that routed HoD can review request details, attachments, and policy context before deciding request.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated; request from HoD's department is in Submitted status.
action_or_input: HoD accesses submitted request review view.
expected_result: HoD is presented with request metadata, attachments, and departmental policy context.

purpose: Verify that HoD can approve secure archival request and decision is recorded.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated and reviewing a pending archival request from their department.
action_or_input: HoD submits approval decision.
expected_result: System records HoD approval decision and updates request state.

purpose: Verify that HoD can reject secure archival request and decision is recorded.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated and reviewing a pending archival request from their department.
action_or_input: HoD submits rejection decision.
expected_result: System records HoD rejection decision and marks request as rejected.

purpose: Verify that HoD from another department cannot approve or reject a user's request.
preconditions: HoD of Department Y is authenticated; request belongs to user of Department X.
action_or_input: HoD of Department Y attempts to approve or reject the request.
expected_result: System blocks the action with an authorization error and keeps request status unchanged.

purpose: Verify that after HoD approval, request is routed to SysAdmin for classification.
preconditions: HoD approves secure archival request.
action_or_input: System executes post-approval routing.
expected_result: Request is routed to SysAdmin queue awaiting authoritative classification.

purpose: Verify that SysAdmin can review approved request and assign authoritative classification.
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; request is in pending classification status.
action_or_input: SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification as Critical, Sensitive, Routine, or Archival.
expected_result: System updates request with the selected authoritative classification.

purpose: Verify that user can provide an initial classification for uploaded data.
preconditions: User is creating archival request.
action_or_input: User explicitly provides initial classification (e.g., Sensitive).
expected_result: System records the user-selected initial classification on the request.

purpose: Verify that if user omits initial classification, system assigns Routine as default.
preconditions: User is creating archival request.
action_or_input: User submits archival request without providing initial classification.
expected_result: System assigns 'Routine' as default initial classification.

purpose: Verify that system applies security and retention rules according to authoritative data classification.
preconditions: SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification to archival request.
action_or_input: System processes security and retention rules for the assigned authoritative classification.
expected_result: Security and retention rules aligned with authoritative classification are applied to the archive.

purpose: Verify that if authoritative classification is Sensitive, request routes to IT Security Team for encryption configuration.
preconditions: SysAdmin assigns authoritative classification as Sensitive.
action_or_input: System updates request classification.
expected_result: Request is routed to IT Security Team for encryption configuration.

purpose: Verify that IT Security Team can configure encryption for Sensitive data.
preconditions: IT Security user is authenticated; request classified as Sensitive is routed to IT Security.
action_or_input: IT Security configures encryption parameters.
expected_result: System saves encryption configuration for the Sensitive archival request.

purpose: Verify that after encryption configuration, system creates encrypted archive and records outcome.
preconditions: IT Security has configured encryption for Sensitive archival request.
action_or_input: System executes archive creation.
expected_result: System creates encrypted archive and records operation outcome.

purpose: Verify that data classified as Sensitive uses AES-256 encryption both at rest and in transit.
preconditions: Archival process for Sensitive data is initiated.
action_or_input: System performs data transmission and persistent storage writing.
expected_result: Data is encrypted using AES-256 in transit and at rest in recovery storage.

purpose: Verify that user can track status and history of secure archival request throughout processing.
preconditions: User has submitted a secure archival request.
action_or_input: User accesses request tracking dashboard.
expected_result: System displays current status and stage history of the archival request.

purpose: Verify that system sends submission confirmation and decision notifications for secure archival requests.
preconditions: User submits request and HoD subsequently decides request.
action_or_input: Request is submitted and later approved or rejected by HoD.
expected_result: Requester receives submission confirmation notification upon submission, and decision notification upon HoD decision.

purpose: Verify that Super Admin can perform special archival operation for Sensitive research data when requested offline.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; offline request for Sensitive research data archival is received.
action_or_input: Super Admin triggers special archival operation in BADMS.
expected_result: System executes special archival operation for extended storage of Sensitive research data.

purpose: Verify that only Super Admin can perform special archival operation in BADMS.
preconditions: User is authenticated with non-Super Admin role (SysAdmin, HoD, or User).
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to execute special archival operation.
expected_result: System rejects operation with an authorization error.

purpose: Verify that system records outcome and audit event after special archival operation.
preconditions: Super Admin completes special archival operation.
action_or_input: System finalizes special archival operation.
expected_result: System records operation outcome and logs an audit event with Super Admin actor ID, timestamp, and result.

purpose: Verify that user can request restoration of archived data.
preconditions: User is authenticated and has archived datasets available.
action_or_input: User submits restoration request for an archived dataset.
expected_result: System accepts and logs restoration request.

purpose: Verify that restoration request for Sensitive data requires SysAdmin approval before proceeding.
preconditions: Restoration request is submitted for data classified as Sensitive.
action_or_input: System evaluates restoration workflow.
expected_result: Restoration is held in pending approval status requiring SysAdmin approval before restoration proceeds.

purpose: Verify that system supports restoration of non-Sensitive data through standard restoration procedure.
preconditions: Restoration request is submitted for non-Sensitive archived data.
action_or_input: System processes restoration request.
expected_result: System executes restoration through standard procedure without requiring SysAdmin approval.

purpose: Verify that user can track restoration-request status.
preconditions: User has submitted a restoration request.
action_or_input: User accesses restoration status dashboard.
expected_result: System displays current restoration request status and progress.

purpose: Verify that user can submit storage-extension request when storage quota is full.
preconditions: User is authenticated and user's storage quota is full.
action_or_input: User submits storage-extension request with requested storage amount.
expected_result: System accepts storage-extension request submission.

purpose: Verify that system validates storage-extension request against user current storage usage.
preconditions: User has available storage quota remaining (quota is not full).
action_or_input: User attempts to submit storage-extension request.
expected_result: System validation rejects request because current usage has not reached full quota.

purpose: Verify that system routes valid storage-extension request to user HoD for review.
preconditions: User in Department X submits valid storage-extension request under full quota.
action_or_input: System completes validation of extension request.
expected_result: System routes request to the HoD of Department X for review.

purpose: Verify that HoD can review storage-extension request details, attachments, available infrastructure, departmental policy, and user justification.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated; storage-extension request is routed to HoD.
action_or_input: HoD opens storage-extension review view.
expected_result: System displays request details, attachments, available infrastructure data, departmental policy, and requester justification.

purpose: Verify that HoD can approve storage-extension request and decision is recorded.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated and reviewing pending storage-extension request.
action_or_input: HoD records 'Approve' decision.
expected_result: System records approval decision on the storage-extension request.

purpose: Verify that HoD can reject storage-extension request and decision is recorded.
preconditions: HoD is authenticated and reviewing pending storage-extension request.
action_or_input: HoD records 'Reject' decision.
expected_result: System records rejection decision on the storage-extension request.

purpose: Verify that system monitors storage thresholds for all users.
preconditions: Users consume storage within BADMS.
action_or_input: System storage monitoring service tracks user storage usage against limits.
expected_result: System maintains current threshold status and full-quota indicators for all users.

purpose: Verify that system validates requested storage against available infrastructure and detects when extension exceeds available storage.
preconditions: Available storage infrastructure capacity is known.
action_or_input: Extension request is submitted where requested capacity exceeds available infrastructure storage.
expected_result: System detects that requested extension exceeds available infrastructure storage.

purpose: Verify that Super Admin can define institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated in BADMS.
action_or_input: Super Admin defines and saves global backup schedule and default policy.
expected_result: System updates and activates institution-wide global backup schedule and default policies.

purpose: Verify that system applies global schedule to datasets when no valid local override exists.
preconditions: Global backup schedule is defined; target dataset has no local schedule configured.
action_or_input: Backup scheduler processes dataset backup.
expected_result: System applies global backup schedule to execute dataset backup.

purpose: Verify that local backup schedule overrides institution-wide global schedule for that dataset.
preconditions: Global backup schedule exists; dataset has a specific valid local backup schedule.
action_or_input: Backup scheduler determines execution schedule for dataset.
expected_result: System executes backup according to local schedule parameters, overriding global schedule.

purpose: Verify that system enforces institute-defined retention rules according to data classification.
preconditions: Datasets are classified under authoritative classifications.
action_or_input: System runs retention policy evaluation.
expected_result: Retention rules are enforced consistently according to each dataset's authoritative classification.

purpose: Verify that when backup is marked Failed, system sends an alert to SysAdmin within five minutes.
preconditions: Backup operation fails and is marked Failed.
action_or_input: System failure alert handler executes.
expected_result: SysAdmin receives alert notification within five minutes of failure recording.

purpose: Verify that system escalates to Director of IT when three consecutive backup failures occur.
preconditions: Two consecutive backup failures are recorded.
action_or_input: A third consecutive backup failure occurs.
expected_result: System triggers escalation notification dispatched to the Director of IT.

purpose: Verify that fewer than three consecutive backup failures do not escalate to Director of IT.
preconditions: Backup failure occurs with consecutive failure count less than 3 (e.g., 1 or 2).
action_or_input: Failure occurs and system evaluates escalation criteria.
expected_result: SysAdmin is alerted but no escalation notification is sent to Director of IT.

purpose: Verify that system issues backup creation-status and completion notifications, including failure alerts to SysAdmin.
preconditions: Backup operation executes through lifecycle states.
action_or_input: Backup status transitions to creation-in-progress, completed, or failed.
expected_result: System issues creation-status, completion, and failure alert notifications to designated administrators.

purpose: Verify that system notifies requester when storage-extension request is submitted and when HoD approves or rejects it.
preconditions: User submits storage-extension request; HoD later decides request.
action_or_input: Request is submitted, and later approved or rejected by HoD.
expected_result: Requester receives submission confirmation notification upon submission, and decision notification upon HoD approval or rejection.

purpose: Verify that system maintains audit logs with timestamps, actor identifiers, actions, and outcomes.
preconditions: User actions, administrative actions, system events, and security events take place.
action_or_input: System records event entries in audit log.
expected_result: Audit log contains complete entries with timestamp, actor identifier, action, and outcome.

purpose: Verify that SysAdmin can view audit logs and activity histories.
preconditions: SysAdmin is authenticated; audit log records exist.
action_or_input: SysAdmin navigates to view audit logs and activity histories.
expected_result: System displays audit logs and activity histories to SysAdmin.

purpose: Verify that IT Security Team can audit data-activity logs for unauthorized access and review security reports.
preconditions: IT Security user is authenticated; data activity and security logs exist.
action_or_input: IT Security accesses data-activity audit interface and security reports.
expected_result: System displays activity logs highlighting unauthorized access attempts and security reports.

purpose: Verify that HoD can view operational reports relevant to HoD own department only.
preconditions: HoD of Department X is authenticated; reports for Department X and Department Y exist.
action_or_input: HoD accesses departmental operational reports.
expected_result: System renders operational reports for Department X and restricts access to Department Y data.

purpose: Verify that system provides operational visibility into backup operations for monitoring and compliance.
preconditions: Authorized administrator is authenticated; backup operational records exist.
action_or_input: Administrator accesses backup operations visibility dashboard.
expected_result: System displays operational visibility data supporting monitoring and compliance verification.

purpose: Verify that IT Security Team can manage user permissions through RBAC.
preconditions: IT Security user is authenticated in BADMS.
action_or_input: IT Security configures and updates user permissions and roles via RBAC interface.
expected_result: System saves updated permissions and enforces RBAC policy on subsequent user requests.

purpose: Verify that IT Security Team can define and enforce security policies governing encryption, access, and security controls.
preconditions: IT Security user is authenticated.
action_or_input: IT Security defines security policies for encryption, access, and controls.
expected_result: System saves and enforces defined security policies across relevant modules.

purpose: Verify that system enforces role separation and departmental scope restrictions across roles.
preconditions: HoD, SysAdmin, Super Admin, and IT Security user accounts exist.
action_or_input: An actor attempts an operation assigned strictly to another role or outside departmental scope.
expected_result: System denies the operation, maintaining separation of duties and departmental scope boundaries.
